Years left blank: FY2013 and FY2014 (classified loans = BDT 0 per bank_financials/NRBBANK/quarterly/2013_Q4.json and 2014_Q4.json — a brand-new bank with no NPLs yet, so the ratio is undefined/division-by-zero, not merely unfound). FY2015 (classified loans only BDT 22.0m against a c.BDT 11,092m loan book — General+Specific provision of BDT 103.9m ÷ BDT 22.0m computes to 472%, which fails this project's own 20-150% PCR sanity check; the inputs are individually well-sourced (2015 & 2016 Annual Reports, Note 12.2/13.2 Tier-2 capital and provision notes) but the near-zero classified-loan base makes the resulting ratio a division-by-near-zero artifact rather than a meaningful coverage figure, so it was left blank per the anti-fabrication/sanity-check instruction rather than reported as a misleading 472%). c2026 (Q2 2026 interim filing) does not disclose a classified-loan balance or a cumulative provision balance — only an NPL% (already used for the npl row) and an H1 2026 P&L provision expense flow figure (BDT 13.41m per bank_financials/NRBBANK/quarterly/2026_Q2.json total_provision_cumulative), which is explicitly not usable as the numerator per this row's definition.
